name: web-app-developers-at-giant-phone-screen-flat-illustration
title: Two flat-illustrated developers working around a giant phone screen showing app UI elements and icons
whatItIs: A flat vector illustration of a man and woman standing on either side of a giant smartphone displaying colourful UI cards, checkmarks, a play button and a chart, surrounded by floating icon panels (envelope, cloud, chat) and abstract leaf shapes, on a transparent background.
whatItMeans: Collaborative and approachable; showing two people physically interacting with an oversized phone makes app development feel like teamwork, not solitary code.
techniques: Scale a device to giant size so figures can interact with it directly.
Float smaller UI icon panels around the main scene for context.
Render on a transparent background for flexible reuse.

vocabulary.definition: An oversized device illustration figures interact with directly.
An illustration with no background, ready to overlay anywhere.
